CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `billing_authorizations` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `pedido` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `authorizedBy` varchar(200) DEFAULT NULL,
  `authorizedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `billing_authorizations_pedido_unique` (`pedido`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `billing_observations` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `pedido` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `observation` text NOT NULL,
  `updatedBy` varchar(200) DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `billing_observations_pedido_unique` (`pedido`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `collection_status` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `pedido` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `pedidoColeta` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `coletado` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `updatedBy` varchar(200) DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `collection_status_pedido_unique` (`pedido`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `daily_reconciliation` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `date` varchar(10) NOT NULL,
  `reconciled` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `notes` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `totalRecebido` decimal(18,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `totalPago` decimal(18,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `saldo` decimal(18,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `reconciledBy` varchar(200) DEFAULT NULL,
  `reconciledAt` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `daily_reconciliation_date_unique` (`date`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `notification_reads` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,

) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `operators` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,

  `accessConfiguracoes` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',

  `accessValorizacao` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `paid_accounts_monthly` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
